title: Factory World
text:
Walkthrough

The tire dispenser at the beginning of this chapter requires a bit of precision. All you need to do is jump over one of the two trolleys, and make a gap between them to slow down the tire. When you grab the tire, it will appear at the ramp that is found below. You have to push the tire all the way to the left, and then run towards the center platform. Next, push the crate to the left. When the tire rolls back up for a second time, you can get the crate through the door before its closure.

Next, there is a gear that can be found to the right. What you have to do is pull the lever to start it, and then put the crate on the gear. It will then slowly move to the other side. Next, ride the gear to the top, and then pull the second crate on the platform.

Finally, use the two crates as stepping stones to reach the exit - one in the corner and one on the switch.
